PRISMA Diagram of the Screening Process

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz(sprintf("
digraph prisma {

graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]

node [
shape = box,
style = filled,
fillcolor = lightblue,
fontname = Helvetica
]

A [label='Records identified in \n Scopus database\n(n = %s)']

B [label='Duplicate records removed\n(n = %s)']

C [label='First screening removal\n(n = %s)']

D [label='Conference papers, editorials,\nerrata removed (n = %s)']

E [label='Second screening removal\n(n = %s)']

F [label='Missing affiliations and \n incomplete abstract removed\n(n = %s)']

G [label='Final dataset included\nfor analysis\n(n = %s)']

A -> B
A -> C
C -> D
C -> E
E -> F
E -> G
}
",
n_master,
n_master - n_firstclean,
n_firstclean,
n_firstclean - n_secondclean,
n_secondclean,
n_secondclean - n_thirdclean,
n_thirdclean
))

RQ 1 (Number of Publication between 1966 and 2026)

df_clean <- read_csv(
  "PhysicsEducation_Cleaned.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

pub_year <- Master %>%
  count(PY, name = "N_Papers") %>%
  arrange(PY)

pub_year
library(ggplot2)
library(zoo)

pub_year$MA5 <- rollmean(
  pub_year$N_Papers,
  k = 5,
  fill = NA,
  align = "center"
)

ggplot(pub_year, aes(PY, N_Papers)) +

  geom_area(
    fill = "#74a9cf",
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  geom_line(
    colour = "#2166ac",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +

  geom_point(
    colour = "#2166ac",
    size = 2
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(1981, 2001),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Publication Year",
    y = "Number of Publications"
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1966, 2026, 5)
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12,
      colour = "grey40"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  ) 

pub_year <- pub_year %>%
  mutate(
    Growth_Rate =
      (N_Papers - lag(N_Papers)) /
      lag(N_Papers) * 100
  )

pub_year %>%
  arrange(desc(Growth_Rate)) %>%
  select(
    PY,
    N_Papers,
    Growth_Rate
  ) %>%
  head(10)

RQ2 (Contribution Trends of Countries and Institutions between 1966 and 2026)

count_prod <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(ID = row_number()) %>%
  filter(
    Country != "NA"
  ) %>%
  distinct(ID, Country) %>%
  count(Country, sort = TRUE)

top25_count <- count_prod %>%
  slice(1:25)

top25_count <- top25_count %>%
  mutate(
    Share = round(
      n / sum(n) * 100,
      2
    )
  )

top25_count2 <- top25_count %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      row_number() <= 10,
      "Top 5",
      "Others"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  top25_count2,
  aes(
    reorder(Country, n),
    n,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    hjust = -0.15,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Top 5" = "#E63946",
      "Others" = "#A8DADC"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Countries",
    y = "Number of Publications"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

top_inst <- df_clean %>%
  select(AU_UN) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(AU_UN),
    AU_UN != "",
    AU_UN != "NOTREPORTED"
  ) %>%
  count(AU_UN, sort = TRUE) %>%

top25_inst2 <- top25_inst %>%

  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      row_number() <= 10,
      "Top 5",

  geom_col() +

RQ3 (Citation and Impact Trends of Countries and Institutions between 1966 and 2026)

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Citations =
      as.numeric(TC)
  )

count_citations <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Publications = n(),

    Total_Citations =
      sum(
        Citations,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Mean_Citations =
      mean(
        Citations,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(Total_Citations)
  )

top25_cited_count <- count_citations %>%
  slice_head(n = 25)

top25_cited_count2 <- top25_cited_count %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Citations)) %>%
  mutate(
    group = ifelse(
      row_number() <= 10,
      "Top 5",
      "Others"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  top25_cited_count2,
  aes(
    reorder(Country, Total_Citations),
    Total_Citations,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Total_Citations),
    hjust = -0.15,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Top 5" = "#E63946",
      "Others" = "#A8DADC"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Countries",
    y = "Total Citations"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),

RQ 4 dan 5 (Topic Modeling using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA))

Import data and data preprocessing (remove punctuations, stopwords, lemmatization)

topic_df <- df_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(AB),
    AB != ""
  )

topic_df <- topic_df %>%
  mutate(
    AB =
      tolower(AB)
  )

topic_df$AB <-
  gsub(
    "[0-9]+",
    " ",
    topic_df$AB
  )

topic_df$AB <-
  gsub(
    "[[:punct:]]",
    " ",
    topic_df$AB
  )

topic_df$AB <-
  gsub(
    "[[:punct:]]",
    " ",
    topic_df$AB
  )

topic_df$AB[1]
[1] "the average acceleration of a car or a sprint runner can be estimated from the time taken to travel a given distance  an improved estimate can be calculated if the speed at that time is known      the author s   published by iop publishing ltd "
library(tm)
library(textstem)

Creating corpus (document-term matrix/ “dtm”)

corpus <- Corpus(
  VectorSource(
    topic_df$AB
  )
)

corpus <- tm_map(
  corpus,
  content_transformer(lemmatize_strings)
)

corpus <- tm_map(
  corpus,
  removeWords,
  stopwords("english")
)

custom_stop <- c(
  "study",
  "paper",
  "article",
  "results",
  "education",
  "iop",   
  "publish",          
  "ltd",
  "also",
  "physic",
  "can",
  "using",
  "based",
  "student",
  "teach",
  "use",
  "present",
  "describe",
  "level",
  "result",
  "much",
  "two",
  "one",
  "show",
  "experiment",
  "school",
  "high",
  "base",
  "author",
  "give",
  "good",
  "include",
  "provide",
  "many",
  "suggest",
  "propose",
  "involve",
  "sup",
  "three",
  "will",
  "obtain",
  "aim",
  "however"
)

corpus <- tm_map(
  corpus,
  removeWords,
  custom_stop
)

dtm <- DocumentTermMatrix(
  corpus,
  control = list(
    wordLengths = c(3, Inf)
  )
)

dtm <-
  removeSparseTerms(
    dtm,
    0.99
  )

Finding the best K (number of topics). Note. This section will consume your time a bit longer.

library(ldatuning)

result <- FindTopicsNumber(
  dtm,
  topics = seq(
    3,
    15,
    by = 1
  ),
  metrics = c(
    "Griffiths2004",
    "CaoJuan2009",
    "Arun2010",
    "Deveaud2014"
  ),
  method = "Gibbs",
  control =
    list(seed=123),
  verbose = TRUE
)
fit models... done.
calculate metrics:

FindTopicsNumber_plot(
  result
)

LDA modeling. Brace yourself. This section will consume your time a bit longer.

library(topicmodels)

lda_model <- LDA(
  dtm,
  k = 5,
  control =
    list(seed=123)
)

Extracting themes with represented words.

topic_terms <-
  terms(
    lda_model,
    30
  )

write.csv(topic_terms, "topic_terms.csv")

Create Visualization

topic_prob <-
  topicmodels::posterior(
    lda_model
  )$topics

df_abstract_clean <- df_clean |> filter(!is.na(AB))

topic_df <- cbind(df_abstract_clean, topic_prob)

rep_papers <- lapply(
  1:ncol(topic_terms),
  function(k){

    topic_name <- paste0(k)

    topic_df %>%
      arrange(desc(.data[[topic_name]])) %>%
      select(
        Topic = all_of(topic_name),
        TI_raw,
        AU2,
        PY
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Topic_ID = paste0("Topic ", k)
      )
  }
)

library(ggrepel)

topic_prob <- topicmodels::posterior(
  lda_model
)$topics

topic_df$Topic <- apply(
  topic_prob,
  1,
  which.max
)

topic_df$Label <- c(
  "Topic 1",
  "Topic 2",
  "Topic 3",
  "Topic 4",
  "Topic 5"
)[topic_df$Topic]

topic_df <- topic_df %>%
  mutate(
    Period = floor(PY / 5) * 5
  )

topic_rank <- topic_df %>%
  count(
    Period,
    Label
  ) %>%
  group_by(Period) %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = n / sum(n) * 100,
    Rank = rank(
      -Percent,
      ties.method = "first"
    )
  )

redmonk_pal <- c(
  "Topic 1" = "#264653",
  "Topic 2" = "#2A9D8F",
  "Topic 3" = "#C98A00",
  "Topic 4" = "#F4A261",
  "Topic 5" = "#E76F51"
)

first_label <- topic_rank %>%
  group_by(Label) %>%
  filter(Period == min(Period))

last_label <- topic_rank %>%
  group_by(Label) %>%
  filter(Period == max(Period))

ggplot(
  topic_rank,
  aes(
    Period,
    Rank,
    group = Label,
    colour = Label
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = seq(1966, 2026, by = 5)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = redmonk_pal
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = 1:5
  ) +
  labs(
    y = NULL,
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
  data = first_label,
  aes(label = Label),
  direction = "y",
  hjust = 1,
  nudge_x = -1,
  segment.color = NA,
  show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
  data = last_label,
  aes(label = Label),
  direction = "y",
  hjust = 0,
  nudge_x = 1,
  segment.color = NA
  ) +
  theme(
  legend.position = "none"
  )

library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

gamma <- as.data.frame(topic_prob)

gamma$PY <- topic_df$PY

gamma_long <- gamma %>%
  mutate(
    Period = floor((PY - 1966) / 5) * 5 + 1966
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(PY, Period),
    names_to = "Topic",
    values_to = "Gamma"
  )

topic_trend <- gamma_long %>%
  group_by(
    Period,
    Topic
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    Prevalence = mean(Gamma) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

topic_trend$Label <- c(
  "FME",
  "ELE",
  "LBL",
  "CU",
  "PTE"
)[as.numeric(topic_trend$Topic)]

last_label <- topic_trend %>%
  group_by(Label) %>%
  filter(Period == max(Period))

redmonk_pal <- c(
  "FME" = "#264653",
  "ELE" = "#2A9D8F",
  "LBL" = "#C98A00",
  "CU" = "#F4A261",
  "PTE" = "#E76F51"
)

ggplot(topic_trend,
  aes(Period,Prevalence,colour = Label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = redmonk_pal) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1966, 2026, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Publication Year",
       y = "Average Topic Prevalence (%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
